title: Chapter 972
paragraphs: Chapter 972
Episode 241. Rescue (1)
Zzzzzzzt-!
Partle was spreading enemy brainwaves.
From the rear, Bakarun's fleet and Eltiot's shockwaves were constantly surging in, and the rest were blocked by Partle's enemy brainwaves.
There was no way out. Temar Vermont's power was at the top superhuman level, but breaking through two aerial fortresses was impossible.
Even if Temar Vermont were to fully awaken the 'memory of the left arm,' it would be the same. Combat power would rise dramatically again, but Temar Vermont could not become a true Genesis.
Swords gathered around Temar Vermont's sword. Rakiman looked down at Ailan and his party, laughing.
"The world has become really strange. Bugs cling to hope until the end... After today, we Red Plutonian will regain a just world. Under the sky of Red Plutonian, bugs will live as bugs."
"Rakiman brethren, it might be best not to destroy that biological weapon."
"Are you saying it seems to have research value, Brother Shimat?"
"Not that. It's just that the energy emanating from its left arm seems unusual. Especially the energy of Jin Runcandel... it feels oddly similar to him. There might be something related to him."
Rakiman did not argue with Shimat's words. Following Shimat's words had never worsened the situation, and the peculiar dignity he sensed from him also bothered him.
"I understand, we'll capture them alive."
Guns sprouted from various parts of Partle's front. As the cannons simultaneously spat out the enemy's brainwaves, Temar Vermont shouted and swung his sword.

A massive sword energy clashed with the cannons in a straight line. At first, it seemed the sword energy devoured the cannon fire and went all the way to Partle, but it was immediately blocked by the second additional firing.
"Your Majesty, please climb onto my back."
Ailan climbed onto Bibol's back.
Temar Vermont kept firing his sword, running forward. Although the retreat was completely blocked, there was no option but to move on. There was nothing else to do.
But the Red Plutonian people were not fools. If the ones they needed to capture alive kept struggling, they could simply remove the road itself.
"Isolate them with bombardment. Anyway, Meisil has no value as a city or fortress, so it can be completely destroyed."
As Rakiman spoke, the enemy brainwave cannons began to fall around Ailan and his party.
They were trying to create a giant crater. The enemy brainwave cannons formed a crater big enough for Partle to fit in and still have room left, not even ten seconds after being fired.
"Damn it...!"
Bivol gritted his teeth as he fell into the pit. Temarl Bivoment tried to jump up by stepping on the falling rocks, but each time the enemy's psychic cannon precisely targeted him.
If he had been alone, he could have made it back to the surface. But he had to protect Ailan and Bivol, so he had no choice but to fall with them.
The thick dust of rocks that sprung up inside the pit obscured the vision of Ailan and his party. As the psychic cannons continued to fall, it was more akin to a one-sided hunt rather than a battle.
No matter how much Temarl Bivoment and Bivol struggled, there was no way out of this pit.
While they were rapidly losing strength in real time, the aerial fortress had not even used a fraction of its power.
"Ugh, ah...!"
Bivol gasped, looking at Temarl Bivoment.
He felt that Temarl Bivoment was faltering, its face twisted like a human's rather than an emotionless doll.
This was evidence that the memories of the left arm were awakening. But Bivol knew well that this could not bring any real hope.
So Ailan, who was riding on Bivol's back, burst out laughing. It was the hollow laughter of someone who had completely given up.
"Heh heh. This is the end, Bivol. Put me down."
"Your Majesty."

"I was born the most wretched being in the world, survived witnessing the destruction and despair of many great people. But in the end, those born with the blessings of the sun are back in the sky, and we are facing ruin in this dark underground."
Ailan landed on the ground.
"Your Majesty, I can still fight."
"Yes, fight gloriously and then self-destruct. They will try to capture us alive. They must extract information from me, and they will have realized that your left arm is special."
Temarl Bivoment nodded.

"Manof probably wanted to choose death too. The enemy race would have increased the density of psychic waves to prevent that. Fortunately, we can choose death. If your left arm is destroyed, it will be a form of revenge on Runcandel. They won't be able to find the record of the greatest ancestor."
"Your Majesty...."
Bivol looked at Ailan, holding back tears.

"I'm a little sorry that we're leaving without inflicting much damage on the Zipfel. Somehow, we had to secure something precious to them. They were the ones who hindered the growth of our empire for the longest time."
Creak...!

The wall of the pit was crumbling under the enemy's neural cannon fire. Every so often, a blue spark of neural electricity would fleetingly flash between the cannons. It signified that Eltiot was resisting, but his collapse was only a matter of time.
Just as Temar Vermont was gathering energy to start self-destructing.
Suddenly, a strange voice reached the ears of Airan's party.
"Ah, fortunately, I'm not late, Priest Luke."
Sun Religion's Shrine Maiden Sanna.
She had just emerged from a newly-formed portal inside the pit. Beside her stood the Sun Religion's high priest, the former war god of the Myung tribe, Luke.
As soon as Luke appeared, the neural cannons raining down inside the pit suddenly stopped.
It wasn't that the enemy Myung had sensed something odd and halted their bombardment.
Luke's emitted energy had bound the falling neural cannons in place. The cannons, bound in neural energy, momentarily wobbled before going out like candles.
"You are."
"The Shrine Maiden of the Sun Religion, Sanna. Pleased to meet you, Aryan Vermont."
Sanna slightly bowed her head as she spoke.
"Ah... Surely you didn't come to save us?"
"More accurately, I've come to take Temar Runcandel's left arm. We're in a hurry now, so let's talk later. Priest Luke, we need to buy time to open the portal again."
"Understood."
As Luke reached out, a sword as big as his stature was summoned.
"This, don't tell me another god has appeared!?"
Rakiman shouted, looking towards the Pibil battlefield. Eltiot was still facing Pibil.
"It's a different person, fellow Rakiman. The Sun Religion, it must be them."
Uduk! Shimat spat out the words.

It was a support they hadn't anticipated at all. The royal family was an isolated force the moment the Myung tribe left. They were also hostile with the Vamel Alliance, Lutero Federation, Kinzelo, and all human forces.

'I thought if anyone would come to support us, it would be Kinzelo, but it's the Sun Religion. What reason do they have to help the royal family now? Could it be because of that biological weapon's left arm? And has the relationship between the Sun Religion and Zipfel ended since Keliak took power?'
Several assumptions flashed through his mind.
How exactly did the Sun Religion realize the royal family's crisis? How did they manage to reach here? And who was that monster?
But there was no time to think. The moment Rakiman and Shimat shifted their gaze back to the pit, Luke's great sword was already tearing through Patil's protective shield.
Squeak-!
As soon as the protective shield cracked, Luke bounced his body like an arrow in midair, instantly closing the distance with Patlok's main body.
The red brain cannons tried to intercept him, but like moths to a flame, they were futilely extinguished.

Luke, the former warrior of the Myoung Clan, was an individual hailed as the strongest half a generation ago. He overwhelmed in the realm of the fire god Xhinu, and even Ayula once said he could only face him with 'resolution.'
With each swing of Luke's sword, a lightning storm spread, covering the area around Pivil. Pivil's outer armor was tearing and bursting like thin skin.
"Comrade Shimat, should I go out and hold him off for a moment?"
"You can't, Comrade Rakiman. If you go now, you'll die."
Shimat answered without a moment's hesitation.
"But this way, Patlok will be hit."
"It's better to lose Rakiman comrade than that. Pivil can be fixed. Above all, he probably doesn't want to fight us properly either."
The Sun God's Church's goal was to save the Idran party. Even with Luke, there was no reason to wage an all-out battle with two airborne fortresses.
"As long as the power source is fine, we can fix any minor damage. Just deal with it moderately, and he'll leave on his own. He's obviously opening a dimensional gate."
Then Shimat picked up a communicator to inform Bakarun of the situation. They would continue to handle this side, and he should focus solely on obtaining Eltiot's blood.
"Sanna, what happens to us now?"
While Luke was attacking Patlok, Bivol opened his mouth.
"It's not that complicated, Bivol. The two royal members will now have to work for the Sun God's Church. Nothing special, you just have to stay alive. In our temple."
"What do you mean?"

"What we need is not the technology of the royal family or hidden methods or anything like that. Idran and Bivol themselves have no value. As I said, we only need Temar's left arm. But since Idran probably made sure that this left arm cannot be used without his authorization, we have to save him too, unfortunately."
"What you say is true, Temar's left arm cannot be used without my authorization. But Sanna, why do you need Temar's left arm?"
When Idran asked, Sanna responded with a cold smile that seemed to ignore him.
"Idran, do you know that Barisada is the key that can unlock the ancient secrets of the world?"
"I've never heard of that."

"That's why his left arm was too much for you. You probably just thought of this left arm as a collection of all sorts of information... but that's the wrong approach. The value that Temar's physical body possesses is in the ability to properly use Barisada. The opening of that secret door is a privilege granted only to Temar."
